brief: Two bases side by side joined with side connectors, each with a bin.

requirements.evidence: piece:0,0,0;full and piece:1,0,0;full placed side by side at level 0
connector:0#0,0|1,0 (side-connector-double) on the wall between the two cells; check_build shows the two cells as separate groups joined by that connector
bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full and bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full, one full-depth bin in each base

finish.summary: Two full bases side by side at 0,0 and 1,0, joined on their shared wall by a double side connector (they remain two groups joined by the connector, as check_build confirms), with a full-depth bin dropped into each. Open faces were capped and joints locked; check_build reports no issues and meshClash clear.

cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes

result.note: A side connector joins two bases that stand side by side on the same storey. Bases that touch with no connector on the wall between them are one body (joint bolts); every wall between two groups needs a connector, walls inside a group stay bare. get_build lists each touching wall and the groups. No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.

events.text: Second base is in place. Now I'll add the side connector joining them, then fit a bin in each base.
Both bins are in. Now the house rules — capping open faces and locking the joints — then I'll verify the build.

result.note: ok covers rule errors only. meshClash must read "clear" for the meshes to be checked and clear.
